questions.question: Stinky has two creature rows that disagree. One (rt-7cf25d) is species "Goblinoid", body plan "quadruped", size "Huge", owned by house Jarraxus, with the Cattlepos statline (might 8, endurance 30). The other (rt-b1bbd0) is species "Calderan", body plan "humanoid", size "Big", status "Alive", role "Bledger's Cattlepos companion, 3/5 attunement stars", no owner. Which row is Stinky, and does the other one go?

The Cattlepos creature type (rt-8ad790) has body plan "humanoid", but Stinky's Cattlepos row (rt-7cf25d) is "quadruped" and the Cattlepos trance card's flavor reads "A large beast of burden with tusks & a mace tail". Is a Cattlepos humanoid or quadruped?

The companion kind "beast" (relationship "Attunement", points "attunement point") is bound to the vocation Berserker 2.0, whose description says "Unreleased. Assign to nobody until Reece releases 2.0; the live Berserker is untouched." Yet four beasts are owned by houses today: Jimothy and Stinky (Jarraxus), Grackle (Shawnanigans), Phteve (Serenity), and Bledger and Korven practise the live Berserker. Does the beast bond belong to the live Berserker now, or do these four sit outside the companion system until 2.0 is released?

The rule world.shear_m has status "canon" with value 2, but its own note says "the number is Claude's until Reece has seen a place shear". Is 2 metres canon, or should the rule be marked pending until you have seen a location shear?

The rule soul.willpower_bonus_divisor is "pending" at 2; its note says "Per die is canon; the divisor is Claude's." Willpower bonus per die = ⌊Willpower ÷ 2⌋ as it stands. Do you lock 2, or pick another divisor?

The rule companion.death_penalty_points is "pending" at 2; its note quotes you, "subtract some points", and says the amount is Claude's. How many points come off a bond's ledger when its companion dies?

Quiver exists twice in Equipment with different slot rules. equ-381924: slot "Hip", category "Hip Mounted", description "Required for Bows & Crossbows", completion "Incomplete". equ-kit-quiver: slots "back", "hip_1", "hip_2", no description. Which slots does a Quiver take, and do both rows stay?

Four foci carry a slot count of 1 in the Foci table while their gear descriptions still say "Slot count PENDING (1)": Amulet ("A worn foci"), Glove ("A worn foci"), Staff ("A held foci"), Wand ("A held foci"). Spike (2) and Stave (5) are settled by the March kit. Is 1 slot final for these four?

Subspace exists twice in Locations. Row 66 is on the surface at hex 3038, node key "center", level 1, with the description "so very kinky". Row 67 is flagged is_meta with no hex. Which one is the real Subspace, and is the other a meta container to keep?

The shop "The Ferry Walk Market" has no location (location_id 0), while "The Ferry Landing Market" sits at Ferry Landing (location 46 / shop location 63). Where is The Ferry Walk Market, or is it the same market under an older name?

Twenty-two creatures carry a vocation that is not in the Vocations table (which holds Ranger, Berserker, Channeler and the 2.0 pair): Inquisitor (Galedrial, Palen, the unnamed Inquisitor), Soldier (the Chapter and Ash Grove grunts), Mercenary (Red Band, Captain Mandy), Artificer (Leela, Captain Jack Black), Druid (Sennick), Revenant (Rathos), Arborist and Shaman (the Keethee), Sensate (Mordant), Delver (Oldin), Tinkerer (Walker), Scribe, Aeromancer and Geomancer "(Elementalist)" (Jeckil, Dalenar), Lector (Silfrena), and "Inquisitor / Channeler" (Eternal Chapter Sensate). Are these vocations to be added as rows, or NPC labels that stay as free text?

The creature "[Inquisitor — Needs Name]" (Riftian, status Alive, role "Sensate investigator, commands husks, dispatched to Ironwood Hovel") still has its placeholder name. What is this Inquisitor called?

Trapper exists twice as an unnamed creature type: rt-512fcf has a statline (endurance 10, prowess 2, intuition 2); rt-ab319f is a scratch row with no stats and, unlike the scratch rows for Zinther, Leanda, Galium and Wheeler, no named child. Keep both, or is the scratch Trapper a leftover?

The vocation Ranger (energy kind "reagents") has no description; Semille and Verdant practise it. A sentence for the vocation?
The vocation Berserker (energy kind "reagents") has no description; Bledger and Korven practise it. A sentence for the vocation?
The vocation Channeler (energy kind "soul") has no description; the companion kind "spirit" ("Spirit weaving") is bound to it. A sentence for the vocation?
Bledger (house Jarraxus, Berserker, trance stage 2, active trance Scuttle Bat, 500 salt) has no description. Who is Bledger?
Korven (house Shawnanigans, Berserker, trance stage 2, active trance Warg) has no description. Who is Korven?

The retinue template "Cackler Pack" (side gm, hostility neutral) has no description. What is a Cackler pack, in a line?

The five base Batkin types have no tagline or bio: Fishing, Insectivore, Carni, Tent-maker, Vampiric Batkin (each with its armed variants under it). A tagline for each base type?

Next armaments without a description: Buckler, Dagger, Mace, Warhammer, Javelin, Light Crossbow. A line each?

Abilities without an effect text, most-linked first: Crossbow Reload, Acid Spray, Crushing Claw, Digging Claw Grab, Matchlock Reload. What does each do?
More abilities without an effect text: Flee, Heal, Tail Fan Slap. What does each do?
Equipment without a description, most-linked first: Brigandine, Satchel, Full Plate, Belt, Cuirass, Expedition Pack. A line each?

The factions The Underworld, The Sensates and The Runites have only a name. The Guild asks "How do we distribute wealth?" and The Druidic Circle "How do we adapt to the wilds?", each with three branches. What is each of the other three factions' axis?
Gear without a description, after Bone and Stones: Logs, Sticks, Verdant Vine, Chitin. A line each?
